# Indigo

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Canadian bookstore chain with an online store at indigo.ca selling books, gifts, home and kids products, toys and stationery on Shopify. States free standard shipping to Canadian addresses over 49 dollars and free pickup in store.
